items.title: Earl King Interview, 1980-04-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Let's listen, this is Cliff's recording of things I used to do.

ctx.x: He said, I don't know if he was a guitarist, but he would get him, if he would get a vocal of attention, then he would do it, you know. But he would get away with it, he would do it, but he had meaning to it. He was saying things, you know.
Let's listen, this is Cliff's recording of things I used to do.
Lord, I want you to go away. The things that I used to do, Lord, I want you to go away. Lord, I used to let it hold your hand, baby. Pride, big enough for me.
